requirements.text: Each page has a title, description and absolute canonical URL
Open Graph and Twitter card tags are emitted with absolute image and page URLs
Metadata values are HTML-escaped so user-supplied titles cannot inject markup
JSON-LD is serialized so it cannot break out of its script element (</script>, U+2028/2029)
JSON-LD uses schema.org types with the properties required for the intended rich result
Tags are present in the server-rendered HTML so crawlers see them without running JavaScript
Share images exist at the recommended size (about 1200x630) and are reachable without authentication
